note: Application of Shin et al. (2021) to this dataset, not a reproduction of published scores. Training groups are consecutive filename-number blocks, not verified people or sessions. Nearby numbered images stay together; correlation across blocks can remain. Cross-validation is exploratory and does not establish person-independent accuracy. 26 supplied test photos duplicate training pixels and were excluded as test examples. No independent final-test photos remain; results are development cross-validation only.
